# Source map

What each source file is. A blank description means the file has no header comment yet: add one and run `make docs`.

## Pipeline (Celery app and tasks)

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`app/analysis.py`](../../app/analysis.py) | The "business logic": fake transcription/diarization and the aggregation of chunk results. |
| [`app/bootstrap.py`](../../app/bootstrap.py) | One-shot setup, run by the `bootstrap` compose service before anything else starts. |
| [`app/calls.py`](../../app/calls.py) | Starting a call pipeline: one implementation shared by the HTTP API and the visualizer's scenario catalog. |
| [`app/celery_app.py`](../../app/celery_app.py) | The Celery application. All reliability-relevant settings live in config.build_celery_config(). |
| [`app/chaos/prefetch_demo.py`](../../app/chaos/prefetch_demo.py) | Show what worker_prefetch_multiplier does to fairness. No failures involved. |
| [`app/chaos/spot_killer.py`](../../app/chaos/spot_killer.py) | Spot Instance chaos simulator. |
| [`app/errors.py`](../../app/errors.py) | The error taxonomy that drives retry decisions. |
| [`app/logging_config.py`](../../app/logging_config.py) | Structured JSON logging, one object per line, with Celery task context attached. |
| [`app/main.py`](../../app/main.py) | FastAPI entrypoint: starts pipelines and exposes their durable state. |
| [`app/repository.py`](../../app/repository.py) | Every PostgreSQL state transition in one place. |
| [`app/tasks/meeting.py`](../../app/tasks/meeting.py) | Plain Celery tasks about a meeting: the "typical project" shape, for the visualizer's scenarios. |
| [`app/tasks/pipeline.py`](../../app/tasks/pipeline.py) | The Celery Canvas pipeline:  ingest_call ──▶ chord( group(analyze_chunk × N) ──▶ merge_and_finalize ) |
| [`app/tasks/police.py`](../../app/tasks/police.py) | The "Task Police": a periodic sweep that finds work that silently stopped and re-dispatches it. |
| [`app/viz_catalog.py`](../../app/viz_catalog.py) | The scenarios the visualizer can launch in the demo stack (enable with `--catalog app.viz_catalog:catalog`). |
| [`config.py`](../../config.py) | Configuration for the call-processing pipeline. |
| [`database.py`](../../database.py) | SQLAlchemy models + session handling. |

## Visualizer backend (`celery_viz`)

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`celery_viz/__main__.py`](../../celery_viz/__main__.py) | CLI:  python -m celery_viz --broker amqp://...        (live) |
| [`celery_viz/catalog.py`](../../celery_viz/catalog.py) | Optional, opt-in scenario launcher. |
| [`celery_viz/collector.py`](../../celery_viz/collector.py) | EventCollector: listens to a live broker's Celery event stream and feeds a RunStore. |
| [`celery_viz/config.py`](../../celery_viz/config.py) | Thresholds and limits for the monitor (how long silence means lost, memory bounds, ignored tasks). |
| [`celery_viz/derive.py`](../../celery_viz/derive.py) | Read-time views: everything that depends on 'now' or needs inference lives here, never in the store. |
| [`celery_viz/model.py`](../../celery_viz/model.py) | Plain data holders. Behaviour lives in store.py (state changes) and derive.py (read-time views). |
| [`celery_viz/queues.py`](../../celery_viz/queues.py) | Queue depth from RabbitMQ's own Prometheus plugin: reused, not rebuilt. |
| [`celery_viz/redaction.py`](../../celery_viz/redaction.py) | Strip sensitive payloads from events BEFORE they reach the store. |
| [`celery_viz/remote_config.py`](../../celery_viz/remote_config.py) | The settings actually in effect on live workers, fetched through Celery's own control channel. |
| [`celery_viz/replay.py`](../../celery_viz/replay.py) | Replay recorded events (one JSON object per line) into a store: demos and tests with no broker. |
| [`celery_viz/server.py`](../../celery_viz/server.py) | HTTP API + Server-Sent Events for the UI. Read-only: nothing here can change a Celery deployment. |
| [`celery_viz/states.json`](../../celery_viz/states.json) | The single source of truth for what every task state means. The UI renders this file; no state is special-cased in code. To describe a new state, add an entry here. Unknown states fall back to UNKNOWN. |
| [`celery_viz/states.py`](../../celery_viz/states.py) | Loads and validates states.json: the declarative description of every task state. |
| [`celery_viz/store.py`](../../celery_viz/store.py) | RunStore: folds a stream of Celery events into runs of tasks. |

## Visualizer UI (`viz-ui/src`)

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`viz-ui/src/App.tsx`](../../viz-ui/src/App.tsx) | The page: wires the live stream, polled panels and selection state together. |
| [`viz-ui/src/components/Canvas.tsx`](../../viz-ui/src/components/Canvas.tsx) | The lanes: one row per task with a ball that moves between lifecycle stages. |
| [`viz-ui/src/components/Inspector.tsx`](../../viz-ui/src/components/Inspector.tsx) | Explains the selected task or state in Celery terms, with the live values of the settings that affect it. |
| [`viz-ui/src/components/Launch.tsx`](../../viz-ui/src/components/Launch.tsx) | Launches the demo scenarios the backend's catalog offers (only shown when the catalog is enabled). |
| [`viz-ui/src/components/Legend.tsx`](../../viz-ui/src/components/Legend.tsx) | Every state the monitor can show, grouped by the stage it belongs to. Built from the API, not hard-coded. |
| [`viz-ui/src/components/Panels.tsx`](../../viz-ui/src/components/Panels.tsx) | Side panels: the run list, the workers, and the measured queue depths. |
| [`viz-ui/src/format.ts`](../../viz-ui/src/format.ts) | "4s", "2m 05s": short, human durations. |
| [`viz-ui/src/hooks.ts`](../../viz-ui/src/hooks.ts) | Live feed: one snapshot, then run/workers updates. EventSource reconnects by itself. |
| [`viz-ui/src/main.tsx`](../../viz-ui/src/main.tsx) | Entry point: mounts the app. |
| [`viz-ui/src/shape.ts`](../../viz-ui/src/shape.ts) | Works out a run's shape (single / chain / parallel / fan-out then join) and row layout from its task graph alone. |
| [`viz-ui/src/store.ts`](../../viz-ui/src/store.ts) | Pure reducer that folds the server's live messages into the UI's state. |
| [`viz-ui/src/types.ts`](../../viz-ui/src/types.ts) | Shapes returned by the celery_viz API. They mirror celery_viz/derive.py and states.json. |
| [`viz-ui/src/workers.ts`](../../viz-ui/src/workers.ts) | Hides long-dead workers so the worker list does not fill with ghosts. |

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
